expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the cards are vertically misaligned: the Green Bowl Poké card's image is taller/positioned higher while Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola images start lower, so image tops, delivery-time badges, and restaurant titles sit at different vertical offsets across the row instead of aligning on a common baseline.

Because of the misalignment, the delivery-time badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') appear at inconsistent vertical positions relative to their images (overlapping the bottom edge on some cards but sitting inside the image area on others).

The category chip row after 'Healthy' shows a sliver of another chip at the right edge with no visual affordance (fade or scroll hint), which can look like a rendering artifact rather than intentional scrollability.
